summary.headline: Zodiacal Figures and Astrolabe Treatises
summary.text: Catalog entries describe zodiacal figures, the earth and celestial hemispheres, solar and lunar cycles, lunar prognostications attributed to Melampus, planetary examination, weather-sign stars, and Hippocrates’ seasonal prognostication. A second manuscript preserves commentary on Egyptian Hermes, astrolabe explanations, and Gregoras Nicephorus’ treatise on astrolabe construction, with cross-references to other codices.
